verdict.rationale: Mem0's Platform docs explicitly support expiration_date on memories, after which they stop surfacing in search without needing a manual cleanup job — directly matching the TTL/expiration part of the story. However, there is no documented recency-weighting or decay-based scoring mechanism, and expiration is Platform-only (no clear open-source equivalent) with no independent/hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: recency-weighted/decay scoring, TTL duration API, self-hosted parity, and third-party validation that expired memories truly stop surfacing.
